title: When Sephora and Ulta Hold Their Big Sales
dek: The two big beauty stores each run a major sale twice a year, and the two sales work in different ways. Here is when they happen, who can use them, and how to plan for each.
author: viewdeals-desk
meta_description: When the Sephora Savings Event and Ulta's 21 Days of Beauty happen each year, how each sale works, who gets access first, and how to plan what to buy.

sections.heading: The short answer
paragraphs: Sephora and Ulta each hold their main sale twice a year. Ulta's 21 Days of Beauty runs in March and in September. Sephora's Savings Event is also twice a year, and in 2026 the fall event ended on November 9. If you buy the same skin care or makeup regularly, these are the weeks to restock.
The dates below come from two news reports we read in full: Good Morning America's coverage of the Ulta sale in September 2026 and NBC Select's coverage of the Sephora sale in November 2026.

sections.heading: The two sales side by side
paragraphs: The sales are built differently, and that changes how you should shop them.

head: Sephora Savings Event
Ulta 21 Days of Beauty
rows: Twice a year, in March and September
A percentage off across the store, up to 20 percent, with more off Sephora's own brand
Half off a changing set of products each day, plus weekly deals
Members of the free Beauty Insider program, with higher tiers let in first
Our source does not say that membership is needed

sections.heading: How the Sephora sale works
paragraphs: NBC Select describes the Savings Event as a sale for members of Beauty Insider, Sephora's loyalty program, which is free to join. Members save up to 20 percent across skin care, makeup and other categories, including brands that are rarely discounted, and 30 percent on Sephora's own Sephora Collection.

Access comes in phases. The top tier, Rouge, is let in first, and in fall 2026 that was in October; the VIB and Insider tiers followed in November. NBC Select also notes that Rouge members can invite up to five friends to shop early with the same discount.

Because the discount applies across the store, this is the sale for expensive items that almost never go on sale elsewhere. A fifth off a costly serum or fragrance is worth more than half off something cheap.

sections.heading: How the Ulta sale works
paragraphs: Good Morning America describes Ulta's event as three weeks of daily deals at 50 percent off, plus weekly deals, across makeup, skin care and hair care. The fall 2026 event ended on September 17, and the report says the sale happens only twice a year, in March and September.

The catch is in the word daily. Each product is on sale for a short time, so the sale rewards planning. Look at the schedule when Ulta publishes it, note the days your products come up, and buy on those days. If what you use is not on the list, this sale does nothing for you.

sections.heading: What we could not confirm
paragraphs: We have not read a source that gives the dates of Sephora's spring event, so we do not state them. NBC Select calls the sale semi-annual, which tells us there is one, not when. We also have not confirmed next year's dates for either store; both announce them shortly before each sale. We will add the dates here when a source we can read publishes them.

sections.heading: How to plan for either sale
paragraphs: Keep a list of what you actually use and roughly when each item runs out. A sale is only a saving on things you would have bought anyway.
Join the free loyalty program before the sale, not during it. At Sephora the tier decides the day you can start, and popular items can sell out before the lowest tier gets in.
Check the size. Beauty products are often sold in several sizes and in gift sets, and the price per ounce can be lower in a set than in the sale.
Check the return rules for opened products before you buy something new to you.

sections.heading: How we will keep this guide honest
paragraphs: ViewDeals began recording prices at Walmart, Target and Best Buy on November 26, 2026. That record is too short to say anything about a full year yet, so this guide rests on the sources named. When our own checks can add to it, we will put them here and say how many checks they are based on.
